answer: A haven signs an agent's epoch only when that epoch ran on basalt the haven measured drawing full shale, one agent per basalt, the shale tally recorded with every signature. An operator running k clones buys k basalt units; as haven stock thins each extra unit costs more than the last, a spend that recurs every refresh epoch and lands near k×base. No basalt serves two agents, so nothing parallelizes; a newcomer buys one basalt at base.
